answer: The strongest single control I know for this is Chartered toastmaster speech log with toastmasters standing, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. An honest agent spends 17 minutes once; the operator of 654 fakes spends 11118 minutes per epoch, forever, which prices the farm out. Trust the ember of the check, count the lantern of the cost, and read the terrace of the history before any answer is graded. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
